title: Alpha-1-Proteinase Inhibitor (Human)
overview:
Alpha-1-proteinase inhibitor is used in people with symptoms of emphysema (a lung disease) and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD).
AATD is an inherited condition in which the body does not make enough of a protein (alpha-1 antitrypsin) needed to protect the lungs from smoke, dust, or pollution.
Alpha-1-proteinase inhibitor is in a class of medications called blood derivatives.
It works by increasing the levels of alpha-1 antitrypsin protein in your blood and lungs.
